title: S.A.M Sound
description: A sound effect a mod adds, or a replacement for one of the game's own. Most mods need no JSON at all: a file in the mod's sounds/ folder is "<namespace>:<file name>", and a file in sounds/replace/ named after a vanilla sound replaces it. This form is for more control: several files picked at random, a volume, a loop. It can be its own file (listed in mod.json "sounds") or written straight into mod.json's "sounds" list.

id.description: The name scripts use, e.g. "boom" (your namespace is added: "mymod:boom"). Give either id, to add a sound, or replace.

replace.description: A vanilla sound to replace instead of adding one: an exact name ("SwingWeapon3V1"), a whole group ("SwingWeapon" = all five swings), or an index. Names are the game's sound files; see docs/vanilla-sounds.md or type /sam_sounds vanilla <text> in the console. Players without your mod still hear the original.

file.description: Mod-relative audio file(s): .ogg, .wav, .mp3 or .flac. A list plays one of them at random each time -- how the game varies its own footsteps and swings.

volume.description: Multiplies the volume the game plays it at. 0.5 is half. Above 1 raises a quiet use toward the game's maximum, not past it.

loop.description: Loop until stopped (sam_stop_sound) -- for ambience. Most effects leave this false.
